name: DeepSeek-R1-Lite-Preview

lifecycle.note: Offered only in the DeepSeek web chat at launch. DeepSeek promised open-source models and an API, but published nothing under this name and no withdrawal notice, so the current status is unknown.

summary.text: DeepSeek-R1-Lite-Preview is a preview of a DeepSeek reasoning model that went live in the DeepSeek web chat on 20 November 2024. DeepSeek highlighted that it shows its thought process in real time and said open-source models and an API would follow.

access.note: Web chat only at launch; DeepSeek said open-source models and an API would come later.

notes: No relation: DeepSeek's first public reasoning preview, before DeepSeek-R1. openWeights is left out because no weights were published under this name and no source states false. The news sidebar labels the page DeepSeek-R1-Lite Release.
